critical_code_review_comments: ReportsPage.js is 730 lines - consider splitting each category into its own component (SearchTermsView.js, AdPerformanceView.js, etc.) for maintainability.

fetchData catches errors with 'catch (e) { toast.error(...) }' but individual endpoint failures are silently swallowed via .catch(() => []) - user won't know if one of several endpoints failed on a tab; consider surfacing per-endpoint errors.
